description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for the menu_link_content module, including help text, entity type alterations, menu deletion handling, path alias updates, and entity pre-deletion logic.

classes.name: MenuLinkContentHooks
classes.description: A class implementing Drupal hooks related to menu link content, including help, entity type alterations, menu deletion, path alias updates, and pre-deletion logic.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help information for the menu_link_content module, including links to documentation and module requirements.

methods.name: entityTypeAlter
methods.description: Alters the entity type handler for 'menu_link_content', disabling moderation.

methods.name: menuDelete
methods.description: Deletes menu link content associated with a menu when the menu is deleted.

methods.name: pathAliasInsert
methods.description: Updates path alias when a new alias is inserted.

methods.name: pathAliasUpdate
methods.description: Updates path alias when an existing alias is changed.

methods.name: pathAliasDelete
methods.description: Updates path alias when an alias is deleted.

methods.name: entityPredelete
methods.description: Deletes menu links associated with an entity before the entity itself is deleted.
